name: 1921 S. Indiana Avenue — the alley building of the house at 1921 (district draft; refined by T-1946)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads 'On the alley a 2-storey brick stable (crossed square, "2") with a 1-storey frame shed (yellow) joined to its street side'. Backcast to 1904 as a yard outbuilding on the census ruling.

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3151, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 27w trace (s27wfp-indiana_1921-b2), the T-3151 census (s27w-1921-stable) and the T-1837 register row frontage-27w-1921–1923; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3151).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3151 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): s27wfp-indiana_1921-b2 outline (main, frame), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 60% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record and no register row: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. A pair of 2B houses, 1921 and 1923, behind stone fronts with canted bays, on one lot of the 1904 grid: one record until T-1946 parts them, 'rear2B' holding 1923, which the trace reads as a range, at the pair's own storeys. The basement cigar factory the sheet letters is a 1911 use and is not carried back; the 1904 Blue Book lists a household at 1921. Its brick stable and frame shed on the alley stand as one building. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 2626460506 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-district-background-3151.
